description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractUserRoleManager' responsible for managing user roles and permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It includes method signatures for access control, permission checking, workflow actions, and module/screen accessibility, indicating it's a core part of the authorization management subsystem.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing a comprehensive interface for managing user roles, permissions, and authorization logic in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Assigns a User object to the manager and computes associated roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set User object.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Returns the roles associated with the current user for authorization purposes.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve accessible entities of a given type, operation, and other filters.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve IDs of accessible entities based on filters.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a specific entity is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check accessibility of multiple entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve properties of accessible entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to list modules accessible to the user.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a module is accessible.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify screen-level access.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get permissions for a specific screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get API permissions for a given API class.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check field-level access permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve employees associated with a specific role.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract protected method to compute roles for a user.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a state transition or action is permitted.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve allowed workflow actions.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Abstract method to determine states where actions can be applied.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to get permissions for data groups, merging permissions if needed.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Abstract method to get a collection of data group permissions, possibly filtered.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Abstract method to get default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the system's homepage URL.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Indicates if ESS rights are tied to the user's own workflow (returns true by default).
